label: At D2 late in episode: grows after a2 reaches S2, more when belief favours S2.
short_terms: (in_state == 2) * (action == 2) * ep_dec ;; (phase == D2) * ep_dec * belief_lo ;; (phase == D2) * ep_dec
terms: (in_state == 2) * (action == 2) * ep_dec ;; (in_state == 2) * (action == 2) * ep_dec * belief_lo ;; (phase == D2) * ep_dec * belief_lo ;; (phase == D2) * ep_dec ;; (in_state == 2) * ep_dec ;; (phase == D2) * ep_dec * (prev_reward == 1) ;; (in_state == 2) * (action == 2) * ep_dec * (prev_reward == 1) ;; (in_state == 2) * (action == 2) * ep_dec * (prev_state == 2)
explanation: Fires only at D2 (zero at D1/GO), with a strong late-episode ramp (timing). Beyond timing, its magnitude scales with episode decile and is largest when the agent chose a2 and reached S2 (common a2 transition); rare a2->S1 and all a1 trials are low. Within D2 it is also higher the more the ideal observer believes S2 is good (negative belief_lo). The free fit adds that a2->S2 activation is further boosted when the previous trial was rewarded and when the previous state was S2, and lets the belief effect be specific to a2->S2 trials; these raise dev R^2 from 0.43 to 0.58. Observed-only: action and state are known at D2.
